Title: Improved distributed tracing of serverless applications built with Functions and API Management is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Application Insights can now visualize the relation between API Management and Functions in the “Application map” view – Functions are treated as a backend dependency to API Management. Similar correlation persists in logs.  

  

 The new dependency mapping lets you easily pinpoint problems across your application and assess its performance. Refer to this documentation article to learn how to enable Application Insights logging in API Management.

Learn more
